This dashboard has sign-in turned off, so Hermes only lets the computer it runs on connect. To use it from a phone, on the Hermes host: set HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME and HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD in the .env file, set dashboard.public_url to the address you use here (or run the dashboard on your network address), then restart the dashboard.
